checklist_trace.description: HALF B of voice grounding: proof the canon was WALKED, not merely carried. One entry per checklist step on this voice's card, IN ORDER. A step the voice could not evaluate is recorded with verdict 'no_data' and the missing field(s) — it is NEVER omitted, because an omitted step is indistinguishable from a skipped one. Without this a voice can silently apply 1 of 5 steps and still return schema-valid output. Enforced by tools/canon_validate.py nominations <DATE>.

step.description: the checklist step number as written on my card

canon_ref.description: canon principle id(s) from my compiled canon block that this step applies. 'UNGROUNDED' is permitted ONLY while my voice has no canon.lock.yaml — a temporary state the build stamps, never a way to avoid citing.

observed.description: what I actually saw for THIS name at THIS step — the value, not the conclusion

fields.description: the menu fields this step read; must be on my data menu

price_at_nomination.description: stamped by the ORCHESTRATOR from the universe file at tally (voices do not fetch prices)

field_values.description: D-20 anti-black-box: stamped by the ORCHESTRATOR at tally — each name in fields_cited mapped to its ACTUAL value from the universe file (e.g. {"lens_positive": 7, "lens_warnings": [], "bracket.stop": 17.82}). This is the PM's data anchor: the numbers behind the one-line reason. Voices never populate it; the orchestrator does a deterministic lookup, zero model cost.

nominations.x_note: Fewer than 10 with shortfall_reason is a VALID outcome — never pad with low-conviction names (A-C2)

data_gaps.description: D-55 SELF-HEAL: menu fields the voice needed but found ABSENT/null in the universe record. The voice DECLARES the gap (never silently works around it, never invents — law 3); the Chief orchestrator then SOURCES each field (FMP for market/technical fields; an AQE re-export/trigger for engine-computed fields) per contracts/field_dictionary.json and re-runs the affected voice on the repaired record. A data-starved nomination is not accepted.

field.description: the menu field that was missing/null

impact.description: how its absence limited this voice's read
